title: Cleared-BUY construction proxy — relative weights inside a user-chosen book
authority: Declared heuristic for distributing capital among names that already cleared close_call_v3. NOT a validated expected-return claim and NOT a substitute for f_max. The validated factor bound stays separate and can remain zero.
eligibility: stance === BUY only; non-BUY names get weight 0 and are excluded from the normalisation

weave_score.note: Ordinal thesis weave — same sealed z-blend used for ranking attribution

mos_live.note: Sealed MoS clipped to [0, 2] then / 2 — larger discount gets more weight, capped

payoff_skew.note: below_band → full credit (1.0); else clip skew to [0, 10] / 10

missing_input_policy: contribution 0 for that family; if all families zero, fall back to equal weight among eligible names
disclosures: This proxy only answers: given I am putting capital into these cleared theses, how do I split it? It does not say how much total capital is justified.
Validated f_max from the paper premium remains the only claim about edge-sized capital; when that bound is zero, the proxy still allocates relative weights inside the book.
Weights are capped at 15% per name to match the existing max_name_pct book constraint.
Input weights are declared, never fitted to the contaminated return history.
